name: Seamtec Scraper
short_desc: Scraper for the Seamtec SCADA web UI
author: EckPhi
description: Read-only scraper for the Seamtec SCADA web UI (scc.seamtec.net). Logs in with a headless Chromium (the site is a Blazor Server app, so a real browser is required), walks the configured entity pages plus the active-errors and event-history pages on individual schedules, and emits datapoints to one or more sinks: stdout JSON lines, InfluxDB line protocol (QuestDB/InfluxDB), MQTT or Telegraf HTTP. Ships the Weissenberg facility config baked in; custom facilities via an editable TOML in app-data. Headless service without a web UI.

form_fields.label: Config file
form_fields.hint: weissenberg.toml uses the facility config baked into the image. Use /config/seamtec.toml to load the editable copy in app-data/data/config/.

form_fields.label: Sink
form_fields.hint: stdout, or ilp:<host-ip>:9009 to write line protocol to the QuestDB/InfluxDB app. Overrides the sinks defined in the config file; for multiple sinks define them in a custom config and set this to match one of them.

form_fields.label: Failure notification URLs
form_fields.hint: Optional comma-separated apprise URLs, e.g. tgram://bottoken/chatid.
